citation.source: USDA Food Buying Guide for Child Nutrition Programs (foodbuyingguide.fns.usda.gov), Meats/Meat Alternates section: 1 large egg credits as 2.0 oz eq (equivalently, 1/2 large egg = 1.0 oz eq).
citation.note: Widely and consistently cited across state child-nutrition agency crediting guides (all citing the FBG); this repo has not independently pulled the primary FBG PDF table to re-verify the exact figure, per this repo's own citation-confidence convention. Egg size assumed 'large' — the FBG's own reference size — matching egg-doneness.ts's existing large-egg-only scoping note.

contribution.note: This is the whole raw/in-shell egg's contribution. egg_yolk/egg_white (SEPARATE's spawned byproducts) are deliberately not given their own contribution here — the FBG credits eggs as a whole unit; crediting a separated yolk or white alone would need a real per-component crediting rule this repo has not sourced, so it's left unaudited rather than guessed at (proportional by typicalYieldFractionOfParent would be a fabricated shortcut, not a cited fact).
